AGIBOT proposes Worken output metric alongside GO-3 and Link-U roadmap

Innovation Day adds an effective-work metric and new models beyond the previously reported G2 Max launch.

Humanoids Daily ↗29 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 4

Measuring useful output

At Innovation Day on October 29, AGIBOT proposed Worken: active robot count multiplied by autonomous working hours and an output-efficiency ratio against a task benchmark. It distinguishes productive activity from powered-on time, but remains a proposed company framework rather than an established industry standard.

Reasoning and interaction

GO-3 Preview uses a WRAM framework to link reasoning, prediction and action selection. WITA-Omni 1.0 combines vision, speech, conversation and movement. Reported benchmark leadership is not independently verified in this coverage. AHA3 hardware and new OmniHand devices support the broader architecture.

Open-source plans are pending

Selected partners are trialing Link-U OS 1.0, with full open sourcing planned by the end of 2026 rather than already complete. This update focuses on the metric, models and operating system. G2 Max, also featured at the event, was covered previously and is not treated here as another launch.
